title: run(): SSE arm + Message/changes + message refresh
description:
What: Add SSE StateChange arm to tokio::select! in run(); handle Message and Chat state changes.

Algorithm:
1. In event::run(), add sse_rx to the tokio::select! loop as: maybe_sc = sse_rx.recv() => { ... }.
2. On Some(sc):
   a. Set state.connection_status = ConnectionStatus::Connected (first event confirms connection is live).
   b. If sc.type_name == "Message":
      - Build JmapRequest: ["Message/changes", {"accountId":"a-self","sinceState":state.message_state}, "mc0"].
      - Call call_jmap. Parse created:Vec<String> and updated:Vec<String> from response args. Also capture newState:String.
      - Merge created+updated into a unique set of IDs.
      - If non-empty: call Message/get for those IDs, parse messages.
      - For each new message whose chatId matches state.chat_ids[state.selected_chat]: append formatted line to state.messages (use same format as load_messages_for_chat).
      - Update state.message_state = newState.
   c. If sc.type_name == "Chat":
      - Re-fetch Chat/get (same as W2A startup logic). Repopulate state.chat_list and state.chat_ids. Do not change state.selected_chat unless new list is shorter.
3. On None (sse_rx closed): set state.connection_status = ConnectionStatus::Reconnecting. Do not quit — let the user see the status change.
4. Handle Message/changes error type "stateMismatch" specially: fall back to full reload via load_messages_for_chat.

Defensive programming rules:
- Message/changes sinceState "" (empty): use "s-0" as the initial state token if message_state is empty.
- Never panic on malformed state change type_name — unknown types are silently ignored.
- Sanitize all incoming message bodies with sanitize_display() before adding to state.messages.
- Deduplicate: if a message ID already appears in state.messages (by prefix match on the formatted line), replace it; do not duplicate.

Agent team: R reads event.rs, app.rs, client.rs; I implements; T writes wiremock tests; V runs cargo test + clippy.

Tests (oracle: wiremock mock data):
- wiremock: POST /jmap/api with Message/changes returns {created:["m-new"],updated:[],newState:"s-43"}; Message/get returns the new message -> state.messages gains the new entry; state.message_state=="s-43".
- Unit: sc.type_name=="Unknown" -> no panic, no state change.
- Unit: sse_rx closed (None received) -> state.connection_status == ConnectionStatus::Reconnecting.
- wiremock: Message/changes returns {type:"stateMismatch"} error -> falls back to full reload.
